definitions.explanation: the time of day when light first appears in the sky before sunrise

examples.japanese: {明|あ}け{方|がた}に{目|め}が{覚|さ}めた。
{明|あ}け{方|がた}の{空|そら}がとても{美|うつく}しかった。
examples.english: The sky at dawn was very beautiful.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{明|あ}け{方|がた}まで{仕事|しごと}をしていた。

notes:
TIME OF DAY:
{明|あ}け{方|がた} refers specifically to the period just before sunrise when the sky begins to lighten, typically between 4:00-6:00 AM depending on the season.

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {夜明|よあ}け (dawn, daybreak - similar meaning)
- {日|ひ}の{出|で} (sunrise - the moment the sun appears)
- {早朝|そうちょう} (early morning)
- {朝方|あさがた} (toward morning)

FORMATION:
{明|あ}ける (to dawn) + {方|がた} (time period suffix) → the time when it dawns
